scope: Review evidence only; not a calculator dataset

talents.name: Light's Vigil
talents.rawSpellDescription: Applies Light's Vigil to a friendly target for $1310909d. The caster's next Holy Shock on the target incurs no cooldown and heals the target and their party for $1310912s1. Only one Vigil per Paladin may be active in each party.

talents.name: Holy Power
talents.rawSpellDescription: Increases the critical strike healing bonus of your Holy spells by $s1%.

talents.name: Holy Shock
talents.rawSpellDescription: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing $1311604s1 Holy damage to an enemy, or $1311605s1 healing to an ally.

talents.name: Divine Precision
talents.rawSpellDescription: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by $s1%, and reduces the duration of Silence effects on you by $s2%.

talents.name: Divine Favor
talents.rawSpellDescription: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a $s1% critical effect chance.

talents.name: Purifying Power
talents.rawSpellDescription: Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse and Purify spells by $m1% and reduces the cooldown of your Exorcism and Holy Wrath spells by $m2%.

talents.name: Illumination
talents.rawSpellDescription: After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a $m1% chance to gain Mana equal to $m3% of the base cost of the spell.

talents.name: Oath of Light
talents.rawSpellDescription: Swear an Oath to protect target ally for $d, increasing the healing of your Holy Light on them by up to $s1, your Flash of Light by up to $s2, and your Holy Shock by up to $s3. Only one Oath of Light may be sworn by the Paladin at any one time.

talents.name: Unyielding Faith
talents.rawSpellDescription: Reduces the duration of Fear and Disorient effects on you by $s1%.

talents.name: Divine Intellect
talents.rawSpellDescription: Increases your total Intellect by $s1%.

talents.name: Healing Light
talents.rawSpellDescription: Increases the amount healed by your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells by $s1%.

talents.name: Improved Seals
talents.rawSpellDescription: Increases the damage done by your Seals and Judgements by $s1%.

talents.name: Spiritual Focus
talents.rawSpellDescription: Gives your Flash of Light, Holy Light, and Light's Vigil spells a $s1% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Templar's Bulwark
talents.rawSpellDescription: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to $s1% of your maximum health for $d. Applies Forbearance for $25771d. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

talents.name: Redoubt
talents.rawSpellDescription: Damaging melee attacks against you have a $h% chance to increase your chance to block by $m1%.  Lasts $20128d or $20128n blocks.

talents.name: Reckoning
talents.rawSpellDescription: Gives you a $m1% chance after Blocking and a ${$m1*2.5}% chance after receiving a non-periodic critical strike to gain an extra attack. Stores up to $1326084u extra attacks. Cannot occur from Blocks more than once every ${$proccooldown}.1 sec.

talents.name: Holy Shield
talents.rawSpellDescription: Increases chance to block by $s1% for $d, and deals $s2 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active.  Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. $n charges.

talents.name: Toughness
talents.rawSpellDescription: Increases your armor value from items by $s1%.

talents.name: Sacred Duty
talents.rawSpellDescription: Reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Templar's Bulwark spells by ${$m2/-1000} sec, and reduces the duration of Forbearance by ${$m1/-1000} sec.

talents.name: Improved Hammer of Justice
talents.rawSpellDescription: Decreases the cooldown of your Hammer of Justice spell by $/1000;s1 sec.

talents.name: Improved Righteous Fury
talents.rawSpellDescription: While Righteous Fury is active, all damage taken is reduced by $m1%.

talents.name: Anticipation
talents.rawSpellDescription: Increases your Defense Skill by $m1.

talents.name: Guardian's Favor
talents.rawSpellDescription: Reduces the cooldown of your Blessing of Protection by $/60000;s1 min and increases the duration of your Blessing of Freedom by $/1000;s2 sec.

talents.name: Precision
talents.rawSpellDescription: Improves your chance to hit by $s1%.

talents.name: Stoicism
talents.rawSpellDescription: Reduces the duration of Stun and Charm effects on you by $s1%.

talents.name: Unsealed Wrath
talents.rawSpellDescription: Your melee attacks store a copy of your active Seal for $1311701d, stacking up to $1311701u times. Landing an attack with a different Seal consumes all stacks, giving the stored Seal its normal chance to activate once per stack.

talents.name: Vengeance
talents.rawSpellDescription: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by $s1% for $20050d after landing a non-periodic critical strike.  Stacks up to $20050u times.

talents.name: Repentance
talents.rawSpellDescription: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to $d. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.

talents.name: Seal of Command
talents.rawSpellDescription:
Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to $20424s1% of normal weapon damage.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.  Lasts $d.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing $/2;20467s1 Holy damage, $20467s1 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.

talents.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
talents.rawSpellDescription: Increases the Physical and Holy damage you deal by $s1%, and reduces all threat you generate by $m2% while a two-handed melee weapon is equipped.

talents.name: Eye for an Eye
talents.rawSpellDescription: All critical strikes against you cause $s1% of the damage taken to the attacker as well. The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.

talents.name: Pursuit of Justice
talents.rawSpellDescription: Increases movement speed and mounted movement speed by $s1%.  This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

talents.name: Sacred Arbiter
talents.rawSpellDescription: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by $m1% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.

talents.name: Sanctified Judgement
talents.rawSpellDescription: Gives your Judgement ability a $m1% chance to return $m2% of the Mana cost of the judged seal.

talents.name: Vindication
talents.rawSpellDescription: Gives your damaging melee attacks a chance to reduce the target's Attack Power by ${$m1/-3*$440667m1} for $440667d.

talents.name: Conviction
talents.rawSpellDescription: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by $m1%.

talents.name: Holy Conduit
talents.rawSpellDescription: Reduces the mana cost of your Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism, and Hammer of Wrath spells by $m1%.

talents.name: Improved Judgement
talents.rawSpellDescription: Decreases the cooldown of your Judgement ability by $/1000;s1 sec.

talents.name: Benediction
talents.rawSpellDescription: Reduces the Mana cost of all instant cast spells and abilities by $m1%.

talents.name: Deflection
talents.rawSpellDescription: Increases your Parry chance by $s1%.

talents.name: Reverence
talents.rawSpellDescription: Allows $s1% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Consecrated Ground
talents.rawSpellDescription: Gives your Holy spells $m1% increased damage against the first $20924s3 enemies that enter your Consecration.

talents.name: Infusion of Light
talents.rawSpellDescription: Your Holy Shock and Flash of Light critical hits reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light cast within $437063d by ${$m1/-1000}.1 sec.

talents.name: Shield Specialization
talents.rawSpellDescription: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by $m1%, and gives your blocks a $m2% chance to restore $1310925m1% of your maximum Mana.  May only occur once every $proccooldown sec.

talents.name: Shieldsworn
talents.rawSpellDescription: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by ${$m1/-1000} sec. Additionally, Holy Strike now strikes with your shield, triggering your active Holy Shield and Shield Specialization talents without consuming their charges or triggering their cooldowns, and allowing you to Block spells for $1328551d.

talents.name: Swift Judgement
talents.rawSpellDescription: Unleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. Does not share a cooldown with your Judgement ability.

talents.name: Iron Creed
talents.rawSpellDescription: Increases the threat generated by your Holy Strike ability by $m1%. While Righteous Fury is active, Holy Strike also reduces your damage taken by $m2% for $1311033d.

talents.name: Champion of the Light
talents.rawSpellDescription: Increases your spell damage by up to $m1% of your Intellect, and reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by ${$m2/-1000}.1 sec.

talents.name: Turn Evil
talents.rawSpellDescription: Reduces the cast time of your Turn Undead spell by ${$s1/-1000}.1 sec, its cooldown by ${$s2/-1000} sec, and allows it to affect Demons.

talents.name: Divine Strength
talents.rawSpellDescription: Increases your Strength by $s1%.

talents.name: Boundless Light
talents.rawSpellDescription: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock spell by $s1% when cast on allies not affected by your Oath of Light.
